title: To Meet
synopsis: Uncover the mysterious connection between Changping and a girl named Baixue in this intriguing tale. As memories resurface, Changping's journey to rediscover his past takes an unexpected turn. Who is Baixue, and what secrets lie within the paintings?

fullText.simplified:
十四、白雪是谁？

    常平看看自己的房间，问：“这是我的病房吗？”
    牛医生点点头，说：“是的，这是你的病房，但以前你总说这是你的办公室。”
    常平又想了一会儿，然后问：“我总能遇到一个女孩子，她叫‘白雪’，她……她是谁？”
    牛医生看着常平，说：“她就是你。那个孩子就是你。不只是‘白雪’，以前你也遇到过其他的小朋友，有时候是小女孩，有时候是小男孩。有时候她叫‘白雪’，有时候他叫‘Max’。这些孩子都是你，是你想出来的人，他们不是真的。”
    常平看着牛医生，看了很久，没有说话。
    牛医生拿过来一些画，然后说：“常平，你现在能想起小时候的事了吗？能告诉我吗？画下来也可以。”
    常平认识这些画，他说：“这些是我画的，对吗？”
    牛医生点点头说：“这些都是你画的。每次你的病好一些的时候，你就会画一张。从画上，我能知道，你可以想起来的事情越来越多了。所以，这次你再画一张，好吗？”
    常平拿起笔和纸，他努力地想了想，这次他先画了一个篮球，上面写着“James”。和以前不一样，这是第一次，他画了篮球，然后他又画那个高高的人，奇怪的脸，三只眼睛，两张嘴……
    牛医生看到篮球，觉得奇怪极了：“这是你送给我的那个篮球吗？还是你以前就见过这个篮球？”
    常平想了想，说：“应该是以前就见过了，虽然记不清楚，但我知道自己以前见过这样一个球。可能就是因为这个原因，我才送了个一样的篮球给你。”
    牛医生想了一会儿，然后看了看画里篮球和奇怪的人，问道：“篮球是这个人的吗？这个人是谁？他也喜欢篮球和James吗？你在哪儿见过这个篮球？什么时候见过？除了篮球，你还见到过什么？”
    “这个人是谁？在哪儿见过？什么时候……”常平努力地想，但是他一点儿也想不起来。
    “我……我记不清，我……我的头，好疼。”常平把手放在了头上，他的头很疼。
    “没事没事，不着急，以后你再慢慢想，现在先休息。”牛医生说道。
    牛医生决定给常平一些时间，他把药和水放在桌子上，就走了。
    几个星期后，晚上十二点。
    常平站在八楼的电梯门口，他想去十楼，但电梯一直没有来。他等了一会儿，才发现电梯好像坏了。
    五分钟过去了，电梯还是坏的。
    唉，没办法，还是要走楼梯。
    楼道里没有灯，特别黑。在黑黑的楼梯间，他看见一个十二三岁的孩子，又瘦又小，没有穿鞋……
    “你好，我是这里的医生。我叫常平，你叫什么名字？”
    ……
fullText.traditional:
十四、白雪是誰？

    常平看看自己的房間，問：“這是我的病房嗎？”
    牛醫生點點頭，說：“是的，這是你的病房，但以前你總說這是你的辦公室。”
    常平又想了一會兒，然後問：“我總能遇到一個女孩子，她叫‘白雪’，她……她是誰？”
    牛醫生看著常平，說：“她就是你。那個孩子就是你。不只是‘白雪’，以前你也遇到過其他的小朋友，有時候是小女孩，有時候是小男孩。有時候她叫‘白雪’，有時候他叫‘Max’。這些孩子都是你，是你想出來的人，他們不是真的。”
    常平看著牛醫生，看了很久，沒有說話。
    牛醫生拿過來一些畫，然後說：“常平，你現在能想起小時候的事了嗎？能告訴我嗎？畫下來也可以。”
    常平認識這些畫，他說：“這些是我畫的，對嗎？”
    牛醫生點點頭說：“這些都是你畫的。每次你的病好一些的時候，你就會畫一張。從畫上，我能知道，你可以想起來的事情越來越多了。所以，這次你再畫一張，好嗎？”
    常平拿起筆和紙，他努力地想了想，這次他先畫了一個籃球，上面寫著“James”。和以前不一樣，這是第一次，他畫了籃球，然後他又畫那個高高的人，奇怪的臉，三隻眼睛，兩張嘴……
    牛醫生看到籃球，覺得奇怪極了：“這是你送給我的那個籃球嗎？還是你以前就見過這個籃球？”
    常平想了想，說：“應該是以前就見過了，雖然記不清楚，但我知道自己以前見過這樣一個球。可能就是因為這個原因，我才送了個一樣的籃球給你。”
    牛醫生想了一會兒，然後看了看畫裡籃球和奇怪的人，問道：“籃球是這個人的嗎？這個人是誰？他也喜歡籃球和James嗎？你在哪兒見過這個籃球？什麼時候見過？除了籃球，你還見到過什麼？”
    “這個人是誰？在哪兒見過？什麼時候……”常平努力地想，但是他一點兒也想不起來。
    “我……我記不清，我……我的頭，好疼。”常平把手放在了頭上，他的頭很疼。
    “沒事沒事，不著急，以後你再慢慢想，現在先休息。”牛醫生說道。
    牛醫生決定給常平一些時間，他把藥和水放在桌子上，就走了。
    幾個星期後，晚上十二點。
    常平站在八樓的電梯門口，他想去十樓，但電梯一直沒有來。他等了一會兒，才發現電梯好像壞了。
    五分鐘過去了，電梯還是壞的。
    唉，沒辦法，還是要走樓梯。
    樓道裡沒有燈，特別黑。在黑黑的樓梯間，他看見一個十二三歲的孩子，又瘦又小，沒有穿鞋……
    “你好，我是這裡的醫生。我叫常平，你叫什麼名字？”
    ……

sentences.pinyin: cháng píng zhàn zài bā lóu de diàn tī mén kǒu tā xiǎng qù shí lóu dàn diàn tī yì zhí méi yǒu lái
sentences.english: Changping stood at the elevator door on the eighth floor. He wanted to go to the tenth floor, but the elevator never came.

sentences.simplified: 他等了一会儿，才发现电梯好像坏了。
sentences.traditional: 他等了一會兒，才發現電梯好像壞了。
sentences.pinyin: tā děng le yí huì'r cái fā xiàn diàn tī hǎo xiàng huài le
sentences.english: He waited for a while before realizing that the elevator seemed to be broken.

sentences.simplified: 五分钟过去了，电梯还是坏的。
sentences.traditional: 五分鐘過去了，電梯還是壞的。
sentences.pinyin: wǔ fēn zhōng guò qù le diàn tī hái shi huài de
sentences.english: Five minutes passed, and the elevator was still broken.

sentences.simplified: 唉，没办法，还是要走楼梯。
sentences.traditional: 唉，沒辦法，還是要走樓梯。
sentences.pinyin: ài méi bàn fǎ hái shi yào zǒu lóu tī
sentences.english: Sigh, he had no choice. He had to take the stairs.

sentences.simplified: 楼道里没有灯，特别黑。
sentences.traditional: 樓道裡沒有燈，特別黑。
sentences.pinyin: lóu dào lǐ méi yǒu dēng tè bié hēi
sentences.english: There were no lights in the corridor, and it was particularly dark.

sentences.simplified: 在黑黑的楼梯间，他看见一个十二三岁的孩子，又瘦又小，没有穿鞋……
sentences.traditional: 在黑黑的樓梯間，他看見一個十二三歲的孩子，又瘦又小，沒有穿鞋……
sentences.pinyin: zài hēi hēi de lóu tī jiān tā kàn jiàn yí ge shí èr sān suì de hái zi yòu shòu yòu xiǎo méi yǒu chuān xié
sentences.english: In the dark stairwell, he saw a child of about 12 or 13, old, thin and small, not wearing any shoes…

sentences.simplified: “你好，我是这里的医生。我叫常平，你叫什么名字？”
sentences.traditional: “你好，我是這裡的醫生。我叫常平，你叫什麼名字？”
sentences.pinyin: nǐ hǎo wǒ shì zhè lǐ de yī shēng wǒ jiào cháng píng nǐ jiào shén me míng zi
sentences.english: “Hello, I am the doctor here. My name is Changping. What’s your name? ”

sentence_translations: 14. Who is Baixue?
Changping looked around his room and asked, “Is this my ward?”
Dr. Niu nodded and said, “Yes, this is your ward, but in the past, you always said this was your office.”
Changping thought for a while and then asked, “I always meet a girl. Her name is ‘Baixue’, who … who is she?”
Dr. Niu looked at Changping and said, “She is you. That child is you.
Not only ‘Baixue’. In the past, you have met other children, sometimes little girls, sometimes little boys.
Sometimes she is called ‘Baixue’. Sometimes he is called ‘Max’.
These children are you. They are the people you imagined. They are not real.”
Changping looked at Dr. Niu. He looked for a very long time without saying a word.
Dr. Niu brought over some drawings and then asked, “Changping, are you now able to remember things from your childhood?
Can you tell me? You can also draw them.”
Changping recognized these drawings. He said, “These are the ones that I drew, right?”
Dr. Niu nodded and said, “You drew all of these. Every time you feel a little better, you will draw a drawing.
From the drawings, I can tell that you are starting to remember more and more things.
So, you can draw another drawing this time, okay? ”
Changping picked up a pen and paper. He thought hard, and this time he first drew a basketball with “James” written on it.
Unlike before, this was the first time he had drawn a basketball, ..
.. and then drawn that tall person, with a strange face, three eyes, and two mouths …
Dr. Niu looked at the basketball and found it extremely strange: “Is this the basketball you gave me?
Or have you seen this basketball before?”
Changping thought for a moment and said, “I must have seen it before.
Although I can’t remember clearly, I know I’ve seen such a ball in the past.
Perhaps it’s for this reason that I gave you the same basketball.”
Dr. Niu thought for a moment, then looked at the basketball and the strange person in the drawing, and asked:
“Is the basketball this person’s? Who was this person? Does he also like basketball and James?
Where have you seen this basketball before?
When did you see it? Besides the basketball, what else did you see?”
“Who was this person? Where have we met before? When was it …” Changping tried hard to think, but he couldn’t remember at all.
“I … I can’t remember. My … my head, really hurts.” Changping put his hand on his head. His head really hurt.
“It’s okay, don’t worry. You can think about it slowly later. Just rest for now,” Dr. Niu said.
Dr. Niu decided to give Changping some time. He put the medicine and water on the table and left.
A few weeks later, at 12 o’clock at night.
Changping stood at the elevator door on the eighth floor. He wanted to go to the tenth floor, but the elevator never came.
He waited for a while before realizing that the elevator seemed to be broken.
Five minutes passed, and the elevator was still broken.
Sigh, he had no choice. He had to take the stairs.
There were no lights in the corridor, and it was particularly dark.
In the dark stairwell, he saw a child of about 12 or 13, old, thin and small, not wearing any shoes…
“Hello, I am the doctor here. My name is Changping. What’s your name? ”
